purpose: Select one finite historical-only Campaign060 mechanism from frozen definitions and source schemas before reading any Campaign060 minute row, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

candidate_design_catalog.reason: Same-clock sign recurrence across consecutive sessions measures persistence of a stock-specific intraday directional schedule; it is not determined by same-day market participation, absolute-return mass similarity, or within-day sign runs.
Magnitude-sensitive correlation would overlap signed profile persistence and introduce an estimator choice; the selected statistic freezes one equal-vote sign mechanism.
Campaign056 and Campaign057 already terminalized these exact cross-session magnitude and activity-profile families.
Counting unchanged prices as agreement would re-express sparse price updating; missing stock sessions must never be bridged.
Only the immediately preceding accepted market session, full fixed 238-position grid, and one minimum of 60 jointly nonzero positions are allowed.
Campaign060 computes one direct close-derived statistic and loads no terminal score into its formula.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_day_over_day_directional_return_agreement_238b
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: Repeated same-clock directional repricing on consecutive accepted sessions may reveal persistent scheduled order flow or information assimilation that remains relevant from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.formula: For signal session t and its immediately preceding accepted market session t-1, form 119 signed adjacent log-close returns independently inside each 120-close half. Across the fixed 238 same-position pairs, retain only pairs where both returns are exactly nonzero and return the equal-sign count divided by the jointly nonzero count.
selected_candidate.accepted_grid: Exactly 120 closes at 09:31-11:30 and 120 closes at 13:01-15:00 on both sessions; exclude standalone 09:30 and the lunch transition.
selected_candidate.prior_session_rule: Exactly the immediately preceding accepted local market-calendar session; never the previous observed stock day across a suspension or missing partition.
selected_candidate.zero_semantics: A same-position pair with an exact-zero return in either session is noninformative and is neither agreement nor disagreement.
selected_candidate.missing_rule: Missing unless both exact 240-close stock-session grids exist, all selected closes and 238 returns are finite and positive where required, at least 60 same-position pairs are jointly nonzero, and the score is finite in [0,1].

decision.next_action: Challenge the fixed cross-session sign-agreement statistic against all 91 required definitions, then freeze one exact coverage-first no-return protocol before any Campaign060 source, candidate, or comparison value is read.
